4.319 Task
Definition
A Task is the smallest schedulable unit managed by the OS. The OS decides when which task
can run on the CPU of the ECU.
Initiator
Software and Architecture
Further Explanations
A “Runnable Entity” of a software component runs in the context of a task. Also the Basic
Software Modules runs in the context of a task.
